name: The Puppeteer: Lamentation
source:
It has been five years since the graduation project submission day, and every year on this date, you – William – invite your friends and other esteemed community members to your theatre to witness yet another fantastically grotesque rendition of a classic Shakespearean play.

But is all as it seems?

[From [url=https://aak581.itch.io/the-puppeteer-lamentation]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
距离毕业设计提交日已经过去五年了，每年的这个日子，你——威廉——都会邀请你的朋友和其他受人尊敬的社区成员到你的剧院，见证经典莎士比亚戏剧的又一次奇幻怪诞的表演。

但一切真的如看上去那样吗？

[来自[url=https://aak581.itch.io/the-puppeteer-lamentation]Itch.io[/url]]
